header: THE PAX / CONTACT ROUTE (steps 63a and 63b). "pax number", "phone number" and "contact number" are ONE keyword; the SUBJECT decides what number is meant (my rule, 31 Oct 2026):
1. a department or place of the PAX directory (a full match) -> its PAX number (answer.ts: the card, the number as the big headline)
2. a PERSON who is an executive (ticket 4xxxxx), by name or by ticket -> his or her CUG mobile number, masked, with the existing Reveal button (people.ts)
3. a department or place with a spelling slip -> its PAX number, the correction said
4. anything else -> not ours (a bare "contact number of ..." goes on to the other routes as before); with the word "pax" an honest "Not found"

I try the department BEFORE the person: a subject that is a directory entry is never a person's name by accident, and the directory read is already in memory. A non-executive person is not answered here (I gave no rule for them): the question goes on unchanged. SECURITY: this file reads with the application's OWN connection (getDb()), never with the language model's read-only client (withDefaultClient is the nlq_reader role when NL2SQL_DATABASE_URL is set, and the PAX table is closed to that role on purpose). The people lookups are the existing ones (employeeSearch.ts); the CUG number stays masked, the Reveal button keeps its login check and audit row.
